title: Above and Below
about: “Above and below, and all around you are — you are the essence of all the beauty of life.” Printed in Canciones (Family Songbook 1.1.3) and Elf Songbook p.41 among some twenty books of the collection. The melody here follows the singing on Florian Michael Litzlfelder — Above and Below (Rainbow Circle Song) at Riedlhof.
